_note: Hand-written facts about the one served model. Everything else comes from the live exports. build.py checks hf_file_size against the live taps.json weights_size, so a model swap on the box without updating this file fails the build.
note: Qwen3.8 27B, fine-tuned by its maker for long-form fiction. It refuses less than the base model, so it will write dark themes such as horror and violence when a story needs them. A thinking model, served with thinking off unless you ask for it. It reads images you send it.
